activity.notes: Tshombe became prime minister on 10 July 1964. ATLAS closes this first segment on 31 July because the Luluabourg Constitution promulgated on 1 August 1964 established the state name Democratic Republic of the Congo; his premiership itself continued without interruption.

sources.title: Foreign Relations of the United States, 1964–1968, Volume XXIII, Congo, Document 253
sources.citation_text: The Department of State record discusses Tshombe's return from exile and formation of a national government in 1964.

sources.title: Constitution of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (1964)
sources.citation_text: The Luluabourg Constitution states that it entered into force on promulgation at Léopoldville on 1 August 1964.
